metric_definitions.aggregation: action_metrics averages rows equally; legal_q_mean/std pool legal entries; std is population std
metric_definitions.top_two_gap: largest minus second-largest legal Q; only rows with at least two legal actions
metric_definitions.row_spread: mean_row_legal_q_std averages each row population standard deviation over its legal actions
metric_definitions.recorded_collector: override/outside-mask metrics describe the collecting policy only

limitations: Known development rows excluded from supervised learning; no new-map or game-win measurement.
Teacher Q values and collector final actions are recorded data; no teacher or game replay occurs.
Retention differences are observations and do not establish a causal explanation of game losses.
